latest_release.name: Recordly v1.4.0
latest_release.body:
copious amounts of bug fixes and improvements across macOS, Windows, and Linux.
If you are on windows/linux please install this manually as this release contains a fix for invisible update prompts (plus many other fixes)

## Features

- macOS window recordings no longer display a watermark in the corner
- Window Capture is now available on Windows
- Added an opt-in channel for automatic experimental updates
- Windows now supports **permanent install locations**
- Added the Windows 10 cursor style
- Improved motion blur
- Added in-app announcements and popups

## Bug fixes

- Fixed slightly washed-out colour range in macOS recordings
- Fixed auto-captions and audio on Windows
- Fixed HUD click-through and flickering
- Removed the delay between countdown completion and recording start
- Fixed invisible update notifications
- Refactored the video editor for improved maintainability
- Improved Windows native capture startup, cleanup, webcam sync, and app lifecycle
- Significantly improved startup time by separating HUD launch code from unrelated initialization
- Fixed invisible drag boundaries affecting webcam preview positioning
